## AccrualPosition.priceVariationToLiquidationPrice property

The price variation required for the position to reach its liquidation threshold (scaled by WAD). Negative when healthy (the price needs to drop x%), positive when unhealthy (the price needs to soar x%). `undefined` if the market's oracle is undefined or reverts. `null` if the position is not a borrow.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get priceVariationToLiquidationPrice(): bigint | null | undefined;
```
